name: Kiriko
source:
The maid who serves the protagonist.

Serious, cool, and capable. Spartan to herself and others. She is indebted to your parents and serves them as a maid. She is very uptight and hates erotic things, so when she finds something like that, she immediately disposes of it and gives the protagonist a lecture. However, this is also out of consideration for the protagonist
